\(\angle 2=\angle 3\), because complements of the same angle are equal.

question.prompt: If \(\angle 1+\angle 2=90^\circ\) and \(\angle 1+\angle 3=90^\circ\), what is the relationship between \(\angle 2\) and \(\angle 3\)? Why?

solutions.explanation: Both \(\angle 2\) and \(\angle 3\) are complements of \(\angle 1\), so \(\angle 2=90^\circ-\angle 1=\angle 3\). The reason is that complements of the same angle are equal.
solutions.title: Compare complements of the same angle
